session.title: Monday freshness reset
session.purpose: Start the week with low-cost readiness recovery so Tuesday quality work can be executed cleanly.

dose.cap: Keep it easy: walk, mobility, and/or very easy spin only.
dose.focus: Sleep debt reduction, tissue freshness, and nervous-system reset.

session.adaptation_hypothesis: A deliberate low-cost reset day helps preserve quality for the 2K repeatability work on Tuesday without adding avoidable load.
execution_rules: No hard intervals, no dense gym loading, no threshold or structured MTB work.
Choose easy nutrition and hydration; no late-session caffeine spikes.

expected_result.next_day: higher quality and steadier execution readiness for Tuesday.

stop_rules: If fatigue is already high, switch this day to pure rest.
If any sharp pain or unusual discomfort appears, stop and rest.
